data.name: Janavi
data.gender_notes: Janavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Janavi is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jan' which means 'to be born'. The name Janavi is a compound of two words - 'Jan' meaning 'born' and 'Ve' meaning 'grace'. This name signifies the grace and beauty that comes with being born. The name Janavi carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Janavi usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the grace and beauty of life.
data.etymology: Janavi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janavi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
